description: This file defines the OutboundEmail class, which manages outbound email configuration and operations within the SuiteCRM system. The class includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and managing outbound email accounts, including system and user-specific configurations. It also handles permissions, serialization, and interaction with the database.

classes.name: OutboundEmail
classes.description: Managing outbound email settings for users and the system, including retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and permission checking.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the database connection.
